{{Top|leg}}
The '''Feather''' was a central object in the faith of the [[Cosmic Balance]]. When siblings of the Faithful came of age, their parents presented them with either the Feather or the [[Bowl]], indicating their path in life and the [[Life To Come]]. Those given the Feather were free to pursue their chosen careers, while their sibling's piety was used to enrich them. In the [[Life To Come]], however, those given the Feather would be expect to serve the sibling who was humble in life. [[Bakuran]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Gaeriel Captison]] was a recipient of the Feather, as were her parents, [[Dol Captison|Dol]] and [[Marga Captison]].
